messages:
Maya R: heads up — quickview shows /v1/generate p95 = 210ms but p50 = 260ms. that can't be right, saw it on eu-prod dashboard :thinking:
Jorge: whoa. can you paste the chart? quickview or full endpoint breakdown?
Maya R: quickview -> Endpoint > /v1/generate > Summary. small screenshot: https://img.redwood/snap/xxx
Liam: quick question — did we recently flip the sample_origin default for rollups? last deploy changed routing fallback tagging iirc
Maya R: deploy-bot shows: "deploy 2026-03-19T09:12:11 — routing-provenance: include_fallback_tag=true"
deploy-bot: deploy 6135789000 completed by @ci-bot :rocket:
Anya: p95 < p50 usually means mixed sample sources with weighting differences. quickview uses weighted-rollup by default, median tile uses raw-sample median sometimes.
Jorge: exact problem: quickview is merging samples across client+proxy+kvcache but then applying tdigest merge with incorrect weights. if sample counts are small, merge artifacts can invert quantiles.
Liam: yeah we saw this when fallback routing sent a ton of fast cached responses with small weight but then weight normalization was off.
Maya R: ok so a few asks: 1) can we surface sample_count on the quickview tile? 2) show sample_origin legend when multiple origins present 3) fallback policy should annotate route in telemetry so UI can filter
Anya: agree. also propose adding a tiny tooltip: "percentiles are computed from merged rollup (see provenance badge)". helps caller mental model.
Jorge: technical nit — our rollup API param is currently "merge_mode=tdigest" and we added "sample_source_tag" but console doesn't pass it. Should the console call /api/rollup?provenance=true or do we add provenance to route config?
Liam: prefer making console include provenance param so users can opt-in for explicitness. default quickview stays compact. API change is small: add query param provenance=origins|merged
Maya R: consoles team: can you do a small UX change for Monday? a toggle "Show sample origin" that sets provenance=origins when on.
Anya: also suggest a fallback: if sample_count < 100 show an orange badge "low sample — percentiles unstable". simple threshold.
Jorge: implementation plan: backend fix to tdigest merge weights + add sample_count to rollup response. ETA 2 days.
Liam: I'll open a PR to add provenance param + sample_count to the response schema. will tag @eng-platform for review.
Maya R: thanks. once patch is in, can someone run the quickview against the failing time range and confirm p95>p50 normalizes? will post links when done.
Jorge: noted. I'll add an internal migration to recompute a couple suspicious rollups with corrected weights and post diffs.
Anya: UX note — don't pop a modal, just a small legend/button inline next to percentiles. PM OK with subtle inline change.
Maya R: :thumbsup: thanks all. feel better knowing it's not a calculation bug in the model serving layer.
Liam: followup: PR #1248 opened: added provenance param and sample_count; added unit tests for tdigest merge weight normalization.
Jorge: test results looked good locally. staging deploy rolling now.
deploy-bot: deploy 6135792080 to staging completed by @ci-bot :white_check_mark:
Maya R: confirmed on staging — p95 now 270ms > p50 260ms for that time slice. low-sample badge appears for micro-slice. closing the thread when we have prod deploy.
Liam: thanks — will schedule prod deploy tonight at 23:00 UTC and post deploy-bot update.
deploy-bot: scheduled 6135829200 for prod deploy by @release-scheduler
Maya R: awesome. file a small postmortem note in the runbook so support doesn't get flooded.
Anya: adding runbook note now.
